You Prepare and deliver testimony to Maria Santos's small business task force meeting. Document the concrete changes I've observed at the diner since the spending index began falling: reduced average check size, fewer covers per lunch shift, regulars substituting coffee-only visits for full meals. Bring three months of rough receipt tallies. Speak plainly about what a spending index of 73 feels like from behind a counter. Advocate for grant extension and expedited disbursement for pending applicants like myself.. Savings grew by $116.
